fact: The Auditor General's December 2025 audit found that only 19 of 68 planned UCUSAF broadband towers for unserved and underserved sub-counties had been completed.
title: Value for Money Audit Report on the Implementation of the Uganda Communications Universal Service and Access Fund (UCUSAF) in Increasing Access and Usage of Digital Devices and Services in Unserved and Underserved Areas of Uganda
publisher: Office of the Auditor General, Uganda
